2607.06831.title: Gradient-Based Speech-to-Text Alignment for Any ASR Model: From CTC to Speech LLMs
2607.06831.paper_summary: Speech-to-text alignment means finding the temporal boundaries of each word in the audio. Some models provide such an alignment directly and others do not. Connectionist temporal classification (CTC) and transducer models have an alignment by construction, whereas attention-based encoder-decoders (AED) and speech large language models (LLMs) do not, and their word timings are usually read off the attention weights instead. All of these signals live on the encoder frame grid, which bounds their temporal precision. We study a generic gradient-based alignment that applies to any differentiable ASR model. We take the gradient of each teacher-forced token log probability with respect to the input, reduce it to a per-frame saliency, and decode the resulting matrix into word boundaries with a single dynamic-programming pass. The method needs no training, no model modification and no alignment heads, works across all model families including the speech LLMs, and aligns on the input grid rather than on the coarser encoder grid. We evaluate it on sixteen models from four families, on read (TIMIT) and spontaneous (Buckeye) speech, each against the model's own native or attention-based alignment. We find that the gradient yields a usable alignment for every model, that it is usually somewhat behind a strong native aligner but better where the native alignment is weak, as for the streaming models, and that its main disadvantage is the cost of one backward pass per token.
2607.06831.paper_summary_zh: 語音轉文字對齊意味著找到音頻中每個單詞的時間邊界。某些模型直接提供這樣的對齊，而其他模型則不然。連接主義時間分類（CTC）和轉換器模型在結構上具有對齊，而基於注意力的編碼器-解碼器（AED）和語音大型語言模型（LLMs）則沒有，它們的單詞時間通常是根據注意力權重來讀取的。所有這些信號都存在於編碼器幀網格上，這限制了它們的時間精度。我們研究了一種通用的基於梯度的對齊方法，適用於任何可微分的自動語音識別（ASR）模型。我們對每個教師強制的標記對數概率相對於輸入取梯度，將其縮減為每幀的顯著性，並通過一次動態規劃過程將結果矩陣解碼為單詞邊界。該方法不需要訓練、不需要模型修改，也不需要對齊頭，適用於所有模型系列，包括語音LLMs，並且在輸入網格上進行對齊，而不是在較粗的編碼器網格上。我們在來自四個系列的十六個模型上進行評估，對於讀取（TIMIT）和自發（Buckeye）語音，每個模型都與其自身的本地或基於注意力的對齊進行比較。我們發現，梯度為每個模型提供了可用的對齊，通常在強大的本地對齊之後，但在本地對齊較弱的地方（如流式模型）更好，其主要缺點是每個標記需要一次反向傳播的成本。
